title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji shifted his gaze from the forged evidence to the real suspect, that familiar face made his pupils contract sharply—the most dangerous variable in the chess game had never been the enemy, but the betrayal of the most trusted person by one's side.

text.content: Before the morning mist could dissipate, the Council Hall of Tianqing Sect was already filled with a murderous atmosphere. Chen Ji stood in the shadows of the corner, his fingertips stroking the cold edge of the Jade Pendant, his knuckles trembling slightly from the force. Mo Xiansheng's words still echoed in his ears—three days, he only had three days to negotiate. At this moment, Ling Yuan sat upright in the main seat, and when his gaze swept across those present, that faint smile sent a fine chill across Chen Ji's back. This old fox, what scheme was he laying?

In the Council Hall, a dozen figures sat on both sides. Chen Ji noticed that Ye Qing had deliberately chosen the darkest corner, her face hidden in the shadows beneath her cloak, only those deep, dark eyes occasionally flickering—like a lurking night owl waiting for prey to reveal its weakness. Her fingers tapped lightly on the armrest, seemingly transmitting some kind of signal—Chen Ji's gaze narrowed slightly, today's meeting would certainly not be that simple.

dialogue.content: Everyone, last night external enemies attacked Blue Stone Town, and our alliance suffered heavy losses. And according to intelligence, the insider is among us. Ling Yuan's voice was unhurried, yet every word was like a dull knife cutting flesh, causing everyone's expression to change abruptly. He raised his hand in indication, and a disciple beside him brought forward a tray bearing several letters and a blood-stained token.

text.content: The patterns on that token were all too familiar to Chen Ji—they were the markings of the Imperial Secret Guard. And the handwriting on those letters made his pupils contract sharply. That calligraphy... deliberately imitated to perfection, yet revealing flaws in the pause at the end of strokes. Ordinary people might not see it, but after cultivating the Tianji Record, Chen Ji's捕捉细节的能力 had reached perfection, and he could see at a glance that this was a frame-up. However, he held back his urge to speak and watched coldly as Ling Yuan continued his performance.

dialogue.content: Evidence is conclusive. The one who colluded with the Imperial Secret Guard and betrayed Blue Stone Town's defensive plans is—Ling Yuan's gaze slowly swept across the crowd, finally settling on a silent figure in the corner. Zhoucheng, do you have anything to say for yourself? The named man's body stiffened, his face turning ashen white, his lips trembling as he failed to speak. He was the Outer Sect administrator of Tianqing Sect, usually the most honest and simple-hearted, and had several encounters with Chen Ji.

text.content: The Council Hall erupted, everyone's gaze falling on Zhoucheng, mixed with shock, doubt, and undisguised disgust. Chen Ji noticed Zhoucheng's hands shaking, but the frequency of that trembling was wrong—not the fear of being exposed, but the resentment of being framed and the despair of being unable to defend oneself. He coldly thought: Ling Yuan played this move beautifully, seizing the initiative first, the elders present probably already believed it eight tenths.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan stroked his long beard, his tone becoming increasingly mournful: Zhoucheng, this old man treated you well, yet you... Sigh! He sighed deeply, turned around and stopped looking at him. Everyone, according to sect rules, those who betray the sect and collude with the enemy shall be executed with extreme punishment, to serve as a warning to others. Upon hearing these words, Zhoucheng's face turned ashen, his knees going weak as he nearly fell to his knees.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan wants to eliminate dissent through this matter, Zhoucheng is clearly being framed. Chen Ji, what choice will you make?

choices.description: Point out the flaws in the evidence, directly accuse Ling Yuan of being the mastermind, and confront the old fox head-on.
choices.visible_cost: Offend Ling Yuan, expose one's strength
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan has operated for many years, rash confrontation may put one at a disadvantage

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly stepped out from the shadows, his voice cold and clear: Sect Master Ling, this "ironclad evidence" is rather clumsy. He picked up a letter, his fingertip pointing at the signature—this handwriting, the ending strokes deliberately pressed down toward the lower right, but Zhoucheng writes with his left hand, so the ending strokes would必然向左. This flaw, does the Sect Master not see it? Or... deliberately not see it?

text.content: With these words, silence instantly fell over the Council Hall. Ling Yuan's smile froze on his face, a flash of sinister ruthlessness flickering in his eyes. Zhoucheng lifted his head sharply, the dead silence in his eyes igniting a spark of hope. And what Chen Ji felt was the pressure suddenly converging from all directions—he had pushed himself onto the cusp of the storm with this move.

choices.description: Remain motionless, investigate secretly, use the Tianji Record to deduce the truth, wait for the right moment to strike a fatal blow.
choices.visible_cost: Zhoucheng may be executed on the spot
choices.visible_reward: Grasp Ling Yuan's leverage for future counterattack
choices.risk_hint: Watch innocent people suffer, need to endure psychological pressure

dialogue.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, concealing the sharp light in his gaze. Zhoucheng's life, he cared about; but Ling Yuan's flaws, he cared even more. He quietly crushed a sound-transmitting Jade Talisman in his palm, sending Ye Qing a brief message—delay the execution. And himself, without moving, drew closer to the tray, memorizing all the handwriting characteristics on the letters.

text.content: Ling Yuan seemed to sense something, his gaze lingering on Chen Ji for a moment, a playful arc curling at the corner of his mouth. He waved his big hand: Time is up, drag him out and execute him. Chen Ji clenched his fists, his fingernails digging deep into his palms—hetook note of this, this debt, he would settle sooner or later.

choices.memory_label: 隐忍布局，心中记下凌渊

choices.description: Use this incident to strike back, saving Zhou Yan while weakening Ling Yuan's forces, muddying the waters even further.
choices.visible_cost: Requires precise manipulation of public opinion.
choices.visible_reward: Kill two birds with one stone, sit back and reap the benefits.
choices.risk_hint: Complex operation, one misstep and the entire game is lost.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward, an idea forming in his mind. He discreetly transmitted his voice to an elder who had long held a grudge against Ling Yuan, whispering a few words. The elder's expression shifted slightly, then he spoke loudly: 'Ling Sect Leader, since this matter is of great significance, should we invite someone from the Sect Master's residence to jointly review it?' This immediately triggered a chain reaction, with several elders echoing his sentiment. Ling Yuan's face instantly darkened.

text.content: Inside the Council Hall, the wind shifted abruptly. Ling Yuan was forced to temporarily shelve the execution decision. He glanced in Chen Ji's direction, a dangerous glint flickering in his eyes—he faintly sensed an invisible hand manipulating the chess game behind the scenes. Yet Chen Ji merely lowered his head slightly, assuming a terrified expression, while his heart remained ice-cold and clear-headed.

Just as the atmosphere in the Council Hall reached a deadlock, a subtle True Qi fluctuation came from the shadows. Chen Ji's eyes flickered—it was Ye Qing's voice transmission. He nonchalantly gripped the jade talisman embedded in his sleeve, and Ye Qing's hoarse voice resounded in his mind: 'That night when the external enemies attacked, I intercepted someone at the scene. He carried the insignia of the Imperial Court's Secret Guards, but it wasn't Zhou Yan. That person... went in the direction of Ling Yuan's seclusion cave.'

Chen Ji's thoughts raced. Ye Qing's intelligence aligned perfectly with his own judgment—Ling Yuan's urgency to execute Zhou Yan wasn't about purging the sect, but silencing a witness. This old fox was clearly crying thief while being the thief himself! He suppressed the surging fury within him, continuing to calmly observe the situation on the field. At that moment, Ling Yuan was locked in heated arguments with several elders—ostensibly about procedure, but in reality fighting for control of the interrogation.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan swept his sleeve angrily: 'This old man handles sect internal affairs, why would I need outsiders meddling?' His gaze cut like a blade toward the elder who had raised the question. Yet the elder showed no signs of backing down, retorting with a cold smile: 'Ling Sect Leader is so eager to assign guilt—could it be you have something to hide?' The atmosphere in the Council Hall suddenly tensed, with both sides' factions showing signs of confrontation.

text.content: Chen Ji watched coldly, already formulating his plan. Ling Yuan was certainly detestable, but what interested him more was—Ye Qing mentioned the person carrying the Imperial Court's Secret Guard token who went toward Ling Yuan's seclusion spot. If this lead could be substantiated, Ling Yuan's charges of colluding with the Imperial Court and betraying the Alliance would be firmly established. But the question remained: where was that person now? Alive or dead? If dead, where was the body?

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's voice transmission came again, rare urgency threading through his tone: 'I followed that person to the cave's outer perimeter but encountered Ling Yuan's loyal guards. They seemed to be transporting something, wrapped in black cloth, shaped like... a person. The guards' cultivation was formidable, so I dared not get too close. If you want to grasp Ling Yuan's weakness, this is your final chance.'

choice.prompt: Ye Qing provided crucial intelligence—Ling Yuan's loyalists were transporting 'cargo' in the cave. Chen Ji, how will you proceed?

choices.description: Abandon the meeting, personally infiltrate the cave to investigate, and obtain firsthand evidence.
choices.visible_cost: Absence from the meeting will raise suspicion.
choices.visible_reward: May obtain ironclad evidence to topple Ling Yuan in one stroke.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is crafty and treacherous; the cave is surely a trap.

dialogue.content: Seizing the moment when everyone's attention was captured by the argument, Chen Ji quietly slipped out through the side door of the Council Hall. Employing his lightness skill, his form ghosted toward the cave. The night wind poured into his robes, carrying biting cold, yet his eyes burned colder than the wind—Ling Yuan, your days are numbered.

text.content: However, just a hundred zhang from the cave, Chen Ji came to an abrupt halt. Ahead in the bushes, a faint True Qi fluctuation betrayed an ambush. He sneered—a perfect setup by Ling Yuan. The old fox was more cautious than anticipated. What exactly was hidden in that cave to warrant such caution?

choices.memory_label: 亲自前往山洞，发现埋伏

choices.text: Lure the tiger away from the mountain.
choices.description: Have Ye Qing create a distraction to draw away the guards while Chen Ji infiltrates unnoticed, obtains the evidence, and withdraws safely.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's identity is sensitive; once exposed, it will bring disaster upon him.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji quickly transmitted to Ye Qing: 'Make some noise, draw the guards away.' He found a concealed spot by the rock face, slowing his breathing to near imperceptibility. Moments later, intense True Qi explosions erupted from the other side of the cave, and Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist surged forth like a tide. The guards took the bait as expected, rushing urgently toward the commotion.

text.content: Chen Ji seized the moment and slipped into the cave. Inside, it was dark and cramped, the air thick with the stench of blood and rotting mold. Following a faint glimmer, he finally stopped before a hidden chamber—and wrapped beneath the black cloth was indeed a corpse. When he clearly saw the corpse's face, his pupils constricted sharply. A surge of overwhelming fury erupted from the depths of his heart.

choices.memory_label: 成功潜入，发现关键证据

choices.description: Not acting rashly, but deliberately revealing 'clues' during the meeting to force Ling Yuan into exposing his weaknesses.
choices.visible_reward: Let Ling Yuan lose his composure and reap the benefits
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan keeps his cool, he may miss the opportunity

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not leave. Instead, he withdrew to a corner, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips. He spoke loudly: 'Ling Sect Master, this disciple has something unclear. On the night of the external invasion, did the Sect Master ever leave the secluded meditation chamber?' At these words, the Council Hall instantly fell silent. Ling Yuan's expression slightly changed, then he coldly smiled: 'Chen Ji, a servant disciple like you, what right do you have to comment here?'

text.content: Chen Ji remained unruffled: 'This disciple is merely curious. That night, someone saw the Sect Master's trusted aide moving near the cave... I wonder if there was collusion with the external enemy, or some other hidden matter?' Before he could finish, a killing intent had already flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes. The expressions of the surrounding elders also became subtle. Chen Ji knew he had torn open an entrance, and now it was a matter of who could tear it wider.

choices.memory_label: 当众质疑凌渊，引起长老警觉

text.content: Just then, a commotion erupted outside the Council Hall. A disciple stumbled in, covered in blood, his expression panicked: 'Terrible news! Something happened at the cave! Demonic cultivators have broken in and are fighting fiercely with the guards!' At these words, the entire hall erupted in chaos. Ling Yuan's expression drastically changed as he abruptly stood up—that cave held his secret, and it absolutely could not be discovered!

Ling Yuan shouted: 'How dare the demonic villains run wild in my Tianqing Sect!' He strode out, the elders following closely behind. The Council Hall was suddenly half-empty, leaving only a few disciples guarding Zhou Yan. Chen Ji took advantage of the chaos to approach Zhou Yan, whispering: 'If you want to live, stay obediently here.' His cold gaze swept over those guards: 'You'd better pray Sect Master Ling wins, otherwise...' He didn't finish, but those few men had already turned pale with fear.

Ye Qing's transmission came again, but with a hint of breathless strain: 'There are more guards than expected. I'm holding them off—hurry...' The voice cut off abruptly, as if interrupted by something. Chen Ji's heart sank—Ye Qing had exposed her Demonic Path identity. This was serious trouble. He had to act quickly, or Ye Qing's life would be in danger. But the evidence in the cave... He took a deep breath and made his decision.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji whispered to Zhou Yan: 'I'm going to save someone. Remember, if anyone asks you, just say I forced you to stay here.' Without waiting for Zhou Yan's response, his form flickered and he shot out of the Council Hall like a specter. In his heart, there was both worry for Ye Qing's safety and fury at Ling Yuan's conspiracy—this debt, he would begin settling tonight.

text.content: The night wind cut like a blade, flames soared into the sky from the cave's direction. Chen Ji施展天青宗不传之秘, his form almost merging with the darkness. When he arrived at the cave's outer perimeter, the scene before him made his pupils constrict—Ye Qing was fighting one against five, her Demonic Path mist almost depleted, and beside those guard corpses lay a token he recognized intimately. A token of Imperial Secret Agents. It seemed Ye Qing spoke true—Ling Yuan had indeed colluded with the Imperial Court.

Ye Qing caught sight of Chen Ji, a flash of surprise crossing her eyes before calm returned: 'Just in time.' Blood traced a thin line from the corner of her mouth, clearly injured internally, yet she forced herself to stand, blocking the cave entrance. Chen Ji asked gravely: 'What's inside?' Ye Qing gritted her teeth: 'A corpse, and... a secret letter with the covert code Ling Yuan used to communicate with the Imperial Court.' She drew a blood-stained silk scroll from her embrace, and under the firelight, the words upon it were chilling to behold.
